assertions.assertion: Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded with CPT 93229
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are concerning for potential arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The indication supports the requirement for prior approval of this diagnostic procedure
Prior approval is required to establish medical necessity and coverage eligibility
